name: Run ralph loop
command: echo baud | sudo -S sh -c 'echo -1 > /proc/sys/kernel/perf_event_paranoid' && while :; do ./ralph/ralph --prompt prompt-plan.md --model openai-codex/gpt-5-6-luna --thinking medium --harness pi && ./ralph/ralph --model openai-codex/gpt-5-6-luna --thinking medium --harness pi; done
description: Run the requested ralph planning and execution loop continuously.
